title: Chapter 8 Advanced Fishing Net
content:
Chapter 8 Advanced Fishing Net

At 7:30 in the morning, Wang Shuo woke up and stretched, feeling full of energy.

At this time, he remembered that there was another "Huiling Pearl" in his backpack. He was too tired yesterday to check it.

[Huiling Pearl: Taking it can increase the player's energy by 5 and experience by 100. 】

He immediately took the Huiling Pearl, which tasted like lychee, when the system prompt sounded;

[Congratulations on your upgrade to level 2. You have gained 1 assignable attribute point. Since you are the first player in this area to break through level 2, you will be rewarded with 1 drawing for making cotton clothing and 1 drawing for making a six-piece set of bedding. Weather change scroll ×1. 】

After upgrading, Wang Shuo was a little elated and couldn't wait to open [Character Information].

[ID:5678Wang Shuo]

[Level: Level 2]

【Strength: 5】

[Stamina: 7]

[Agility: 5]

[Energy: 12]

[Skills: 1. "Mixing mud", 2. "Creating mud pit". 】

[Comprehensive evaluation: A subpar little hot chick! 】

"Haha!" Wang Shuo no longer wanted to complain.

[Create a mud pit: Consume 10 points of mental power to create a huge mud pit of 2 meters x 2 meters x 2 meters. The casting time is 5 seconds, the skill CD is 30 seconds, and the trap exists for 12 hours. 】

(After the thin mud is collected, the mud pit will remain forever.)

Wang Shuo was delighted when he saw the extra skills. These were new skills unlocked by changing his job to become a mason.

Although it is a life-support skill, it can also become an attack skill if used properly.

He quickly checked the reward again.

Cotton clothing, something that can withstand the cold, is a necessity in such a harsh environment. What a good thing!

However, cotton clothes and bedding require the use of cotton. Currently, he does not have such resources and cannot make them. He is very helpless.

Cotton must be obtained as soon as possible!

Just see if you can get it from other players first.

Thinking of this, he opened the [Chat Channel]. He wanted to see what other players experienced last night.

After all, he slept all night.

"Oh my god, I survived the first night, I'm still alive..."

"Last night, a group of bats hovered outside my house for a long time. It scared me so much that I couldn't sleep all night."

"Ah Zhi, I still live in a shack, and I haven't found any wild animals! However, I may have a cold. Does anyone have cold medicine?"

[System announcement: Player ID: 5678 Wang Shuo, whose first level has reached level 2, is hereby announced. 】

The system announcement sounded, and it was pinned to the top again.

"Oh my God! Someone upgraded early in the morning. How did you do that?"

"It's so scary, boss, please help me!"

"Boss, accept me, I really want to be your little brother."

"Handsome guy please take care of me, big breasts make me not clingy."

"Boss, I am willing to give birth to a monkey for you."

…

At this time, Wang Shuo saw the reactions of other players and smiled slightly.

Hiding one's merit and fame and keeping a low profile is the way to go, but the system doesn't allow it!

…

Feeling a little hungry, he quickly grilled two fish.

At this time, he discovered that the [Diary] page had new changes.

"My name is Wang Shuo. After hard work and God's blessing, I finally upgraded my shelter before nightfall. It is also a brick house that is stronger than a wooden house. Otherwise, I wouldn't have been able to withstand that bird last night. Of the elite crocodile wandering outside the house.

I managed to survive the first night, but the danger did not go away. I knew that crocodiles would return to their habitat in the swamp during the day, and I also thought of how to deal with the crocodiles, but I never expected that in the end I would become a delicious meal for the crocodiles. "

"I believe you, your 'diary' is very bad." Wang Shuo muttered in a low voice.

Although he said this, Wang Shuo was still a little panicked.

Because he still doesn't know how to deal with this crocodile.

Take one step, count one step!

The most important thing is to explore the territory and collect resources.

After eating two fish, he was eighty percent full. Although he still had some food, he did not dare to finish it all.

God knows if I can still go fishing in the swamp today.

At this moment, the slightly hoarse old man's voice sounded again:

[Congratulations to all the survivors, you spent your first day safely. You don't have to doubt that this is a survival game. If you die, you really die. Next, you will face more difficult tests, and I look forward to hearing my voice again. 】

After Wang Shuo heard this, he didn't have much trouble in his heart. After a day of intense survival trials, he had adapted to this state of existence.

As for the reactions of other players, he didn't care.

If you can't survive yourself, why do you care what others do?

Through the map, he knew that there was solid land within 50 meters of the shelter, so he planned to continue opening the map and carefully explore all the land in the territory first.

He carefully opened the wooden door. It was still dark outside and it was still dark.

After waiting for a while, he could barely distinguish the items. The pottery outside the house was broken a lot. He moved all the intact pots and pans inside the house.

According to the "diary prophecy", he knew that the crocodile had returned to the swamp, but he could not completely believe it.

Don't be afraid of ten thousand, just be afraid of the unexpected. If you encounter a crocodile, your journey of survival will be over.

However, Wang Shuo became much more courageous. Although he still did not dare to let down his guard, his exploration speed was much faster than yesterday.

Soon, the area within 50 meters around the shelter on the map was no longer gray.

At this time, the system prompt sounded:

[The field of view has increased to 50 meters]

[Since you have explored your primary territory, you will be warned when an enemy appears in your territory. ]

Wang Shuo was delighted. The importance of field of view to players is self-evident.

Being able to detect potential dangers in advance can naturally greatly increase the chance of survival.

Moreover, at this time, he can identify the direction through the map.

After the field of view increased, he decided to patrol along the border of the territory again.

He first walked 50 meters west to the edge of the swamp and found a ruin covered by fog in the swamp 10 meters away.

Even when he approached in person, the fog did not dissipate.

This made him dare not step into the fog easily.

After observing for a long time, he decided to give up exploring here for the time being.

Looking up and scanning around, he continued to explore along the edge of the swamp.

After walking for a while, a large area of plants appeared in front of him. He looked at the location on the map and found that he had come to the north of the map.

He collected some, and the system prompt sounded:

[Flax +5, Flax Seed +1]

It turned out to be flax, which is the material for making hemp rope. He was overjoyed and collected a lot of it.

[Flax +8]

[Flax Seed +1]

…

[Obtain "Hemp Rope Making Drawing" ×1, "Cloth Making Drawing" ×1]

"Making Drawing?"

Wang Shuo guessed: "It seems that collecting a certain material can easily be accompanied by obtaining the primary making drawings of the corresponding material. Otherwise, the material is useless."

After clicking to learn, he found that different raw materials can be used to make different cloths.

Hemp rope can be used to make linen cloth, and cotton can be used to make cotton cloth.

Open [Synthesis Formula].

[Hemp Rope: 200/10 Flax]

[Do you want to make hemp rope? ]

"Yes."

Not long after, 20 hemp ropes were put into the backpack.

He couldn't wait to make the advanced fishing net first.

[Advanced Fishing Net: 20/10 Hemp Rope]

[Do you want to make an advanced fishing net?]

"Yes."

Wang Shuo made two in one go. He had no choice but to make one feel insecure.

[Advanced Fishing Net: Can be used to catch wild animals.]

"Haha."

It was as good as saying nothing.

In the following time, he used the "mixing mud" skill to collect flax while collecting resources such as clay and water.

Since he did not need to use tools such as stone knives to harvest, but directly used the "mixing mud" skill, his efficiency increased by many times. When his backpack was full, he would go back to the shelter and pile them all in the brick house.

Fortunately, this game does not have an item deletion function. If it disappeared automatically, Wang Shuo would be in tears.

Two hours later, Wang Shuo saw the mess in the house and his head was big.

"It seems that it's time to make a warehouse." He couldn't help but say.
